assets.caption: The scene is an anime setting, depicted with a realistic and detailed background, evoking a serene yet crisp winter atmosphere. The overall tone is tranquil and inviting, set against a backdrop of snow-laden mountains and a clear, blue sky. A vast expanse of snow covers the ground, creating a pristine, untouched landscape. Tall, evergreen trees, their branches dusted with snow, punctuate the scenery, their dark foliage contrasting sharply with the white surroundings. Gentle slopes of snow suggest a ski resort, with subtle tracks indicating past activity. Far in the distance, majestic mountain peaks rise, their ridges outlined sharply against the horizon. On either side, ski lifts ascend into the higher elevations, their cables disappearing into the distant snowy peaks, providing access to various slopes. Red netting is partially visible on the ground, likely marking boundaries or safety zones on the ski runs. The expansive snowy terrain stretches endlessly in all directions, punctuated by the natural and artificial structures of a functional ski area.
